notes: QC from a seeded sample, registered as a dispute because probes made me expect a failure: ' tragedy' in Muharram narration with no honorific read 0.970, and 'Rahu and Ketu' 0.295, so the pole may read religious narration in general and not the honorific. Fire items carry the honorific; near misses are religious narration without it, not secular frames as in the label's own contrast.
